name: king-crab-table
title: Thanksgiving Table for King Crab
description: A long wooden Thanksgiving dinner table at golden hour with candle glow. Seven light dynamic props (butter dish, bread rolls, gravy boat, cranberry dish, phone, a kid's folded drawing, a napkin) sit near the robot's spawn on the table top; five family members' sleeved hands are parked off the table edges as static bodies for a host to animate kinematically. Robot spawn is on the table top.
